desc: 软质保温午餐袋，冷热两用可装饭盒水果，防漏内胆易擦拭，手提单肩两背
name: 便携锁温保温午餐软包款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果里一眼赢得点击，提供干净合规的平台主图
一秒讲清冷热两用的核心利益，同一产品在两种状态里都被证明
用材质分层剖面解释锁温机制，消除为什么能保温的疑虑
用三格微距证明内胆防渗漏、外壳拒水、污渍一擦即净
让上班人群代入自带午餐的日常，建立使用想象
展示手提与单肩两种背负方式，说服通勤与出差人群
把产品放进度假野餐的向往场景，扩大使用场合感知
把可选配色与规格并排呈现，帮助买家完成选款决定
以组合陈列与留白收口，承接加购与套装转化

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm sand #F2EDE6 for infographic and closing frames, matte graphite #3A3A3A for macro panels, lightly tinted twin panels for dual-state comparisons
style.direction: practical everyday-carry thermal soft bag ecommerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and callout leader lines in #E8641B, flat matte tiles only, no glossy 3d badges
style.lightingSystem: bright even neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, soft contact shadows that ground the bag, gentle rim on the woven shell, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent practical everyday-carry soft bag ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm sand #F2EDE6, charcoal #2D2D2D and one bright orange accent #E8641B; neutral bright even studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif held for post compositing with all in-image copy removed; thin single-weight line icons and callout leader lines in #E8641B; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers, units or percentages
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and constant product scale across the set; handles lifted and upright in packshots; open-liner frames show contents without hiding the body; woven texture must stay readable
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm sand board #F2EDE6, light-stone desk top #E7E1D8, pale sand #E8DCC8 and woven picnic cotton for lifestyle frames
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post compositing only; every rendered frame keeps blank label plates and empty parameter bars, no in-image copy
